title: Preloop versus Agent CI benchmark

comparison.answer: Run the same pinned workflow revision on both systems and compare end-to-end and phase timings.

repetitions.answer: Three cold-start runs and five warm runs per system and repository, with failures retained rather than retried away.

repositories.answer: Use public repositories at pinned commits; select five diverse projects with no private credentials required beyond Agent CI access.

agent-ci-access.answer: Agent CI access details were not specified; the plan must document the required CLI/API setup and keep credentials outside the repository.

assumptions: The benchmark compares equivalent executions rather than claiming identical infrastructure.
The five repositories can be selected from public source with reproducible pinned revisions.
Agent CI credentials and quota are supplied at execution time and are never committed.
